figures.title: 今日图表（彭博 Aug 10）— 中国7月CPI/PPI同比
figures.analysis: 彭博「今日图表」（来源：国家统计局）把中国CPI（橙）与PPI（黑）同比画到2026年中：PPI在能源冲击后仍处正增，但7月同比涨幅回落；CPI同比约0.5%，远低于PPI。So what：中东油价压力缓释正在从工厂端通胀回传——PPI同比3.5%（较上月回落0.6个百分点）而CPI仅0.5%，说明输入性成本松绑先于终端需求回暖；对利率与A股定价，读的是「成本冲击降温」而非「需求过热」。

summary.text: BLS July nonfarm payrolls −23,000; unemployment 4.1%; prior two months revised down a combined 103,000 — miss vs ~80k consensus framing.
China July CPI +0.5% y/y; PPI +3.5% y/y (−0.6 pp from June) — first PPI slowdown since the Iran war energy shock per desk framing.

Asia Monday: Nikkei 66,947.51 (+2.04%); Hang Seng 25,852.69 (+0.72%); USD/JPY ~158.42 after weekend US–Japan yen-defense narrative faded.

signal: Soft US labor + cooler China factory inflation cuts near-term hike/geo oil premium — watch Sept Fed odds and Hormuz/talks headlines, not a fresh equity-beta regime.
watch: BLS CPI (Aug 12) · Fed speakers · Iran–Oman Hormuz channel talks · USD/JPY if authorities re-intervene · China quant/AI fund stress spillover.

themeCards.title: Soft July payrolls cut hike odds
themeCards.fact: BLS: July nonfarm payrolls −23,000; unemployment rate 4.1%. Prior two months revised down a combined 103,000 (NBC). Bloomberg desk: money-market Sept hike odds fell sharply after the print (CLAIM — inbox).
themeCards.mechanism: A downside labor surprise plus large revisions softens the “reaccelerate into hikes” path; duration and risk assets bid as front-end yields fall.
themeCards.trigger: CME/FedWatch or money-market Sept hike odds re-price above ~55%, or next claims/CPI reheat.
themeCards.invalidator: Follow-through payroll rebound or hot CPI that restores hike odds without a risk-off shock.

themeCards.title: Iran refuses direct talks; Hormuz still a premium
themeCards.fact: Inbox: Iran FM says Tehran will not talk directly with the US after alleged breaches of the June temporary peace MOU; Trump says he can wait on economic pressure. Houthis attacked Saudi Aramco’s Jazan refinery; fire extinguished. Weekend tea: Brent had traded above $83 as Hormuz hopes faded.
themeCards.mechanism: Diplomacy headlines still price Strait risk faster than OPEC flows; soft US labor caps how far oil can squeeze growth narratives.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed Hormuz temporary channel with commercial traffic, or new tanker/refinery disruption.
themeCards.invalidator: Sustained Brent break above recent highs on confirmed supply outage independent of talk headlines.

themeCards.title: China July CPI/PPI cool as energy shock fades
themeCards.fact: NBS via Xinhua/CGTN: July CPI +0.5% y/y; PPI +3.5% y/y, down 0.6 pp from June (PPI −0.7% m/m). Bloomberg chart-of-day frames first PPI slowdown since Iran war.
themeCards.mechanism: Imported energy disinflation hits factory gates first; soft CPI keeps policy space open while growth still needs domestic demand confirmation.
themeCards.trigger: August PPI re-accelerates with oil, or CPI dips into deflation with weak activity prints.
themeCards.invalidator: Sticky services CPI + PPI reheat that forces tighter onshore financial conditions.

themeCards.title: China quant/AI funds smashed in July AI drawdown
themeCards.fact: Inbox (朝阳永续 via 彭博): pure long quant products posted heavy July losses; products tied to DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng’s High-Flyer (幻方) saw deep drawdowns, with most flipping YTD negative. Cambricon and Moore Threads reported strong H1 revenue growth (desk).
themeCards.mechanism: Crowded AI factor unwind transmits into quant P&L and risk appetite even when chip vendors post strong sales — separate stock-picking from fund-flow stress.
themeCards.trigger: Further >10% weekly drawdowns in China AI leaders or reported fund gates/redemptions.
themeCards.invalidator: Stabilization in AI factor and quant indices with rising A-share breadth.

themeCards.title: US–Japan yen defense — effect already fading
themeCards.fact: Weekend tea: US–Japan joint yen support (media noted Bessent note “buy $5–10bn yen”); by week’s price action yen slipped back toward pre-note levels. Monday USD/JPY ~158.42. Inbox: Morgan Stanley FX sees intervention effect temporary unless repeated.
themeCards.mechanism: Joint intervention avoids Japan alone selling USTs for ammo — but without follow-through, USD/JPY drift higher resumes as carry/regime assert.
themeCards.trigger: Confirmed second wave of joint intervention or USD/JPY sustained move below 155.
themeCards.invalidator: Smooth grind above recent highs with no official response.

globalRegime: Soft US labor + still-live Middle East diplomacy risk: risk assets bid the hike-odds cut while oil keeps a Hormuz option premium.

globalChanged.text: 伊朗外长表示目前不会与美国直接谈判；特朗普称可等待经济压力迫使德黑兰软化立场。
胡塞武装袭击沙特阿美吉赞炼油厂，引发大火已被扑灭。
BLS：7月非农就业 −23,000；失业率 4.1%；此前两月合计下修约10.3万。
疲软就业后，货币市场定价显示美联储9月加息概率明显回落（彭博早茶 desk CLAIM）。
美国财政部将两家伊朗加密货币交易所列入黑名单，并制裁协助资金转移的网络（含香港公司）。
美日联手干预日元后效应消退；摩根士丹利外汇策略转为对日元偏空，除非再次联合干预。

globalImplies.text: Front-end UST relief can extend if CPI (Aug 12) does not reheat — treat as path odds, not a pivot call.
Oil remains headline-beta to Hormuz/talks; soft labor caps how far a squeeze can travel into growth pricing.

globalTensions: Soft labor vs still-elevated geo oil premium; intervention credibility vs USD/JPY carry. CLAIM: Morgan Stanley FX/balance-sheet views are third-party, not prints.
chinaStance: Factory-gate inflation cooling as imported energy eases; policy still watching soft CPI and property/tech fund stress.

chinaChanged.text: 中国7月CPI同比上涨0.5%；PPI同比上涨3.5%、涨幅较上月回落0.6个百分点（环比−0.7%）。
北京放宽非本市户籍购房社保/个税年限：2年缩短至1年，跟进上海松绑。
中国量化对冲基金7月重挫：朝阳永续显示纯多头量化大幅亏损，DeepSeek创始人相关幻方产品普遍深跌（彭博早茶，单源）。
中国AI芯片厂商公布半年度业绩，寒武纪与摩尔线程营收显著改善；摩尔线程称拟适时赴港上市（彭博早茶，单源）。
美国法官初步批准药明康德禁令动议，暂缓五角大楼“中国军事企业”认定执行。
台风“白海豚”登陆浙江沿海，最高红色预警，逾千航班取消。

chinaImplies.text: Cooler PPI/CPI reduces imported-cost urgency; property tweaks are incremental demand support, not a cycle turn alone.
Quant/AI fund stress is a flow risk distinct from vendor revenue prints — keep Cambricon/Moore Threads separate from High-Flyer P&L.

chinaDivergences: Strong AI chip H1 sales vs brutal July quant drawdowns; soft CPI vs still-positive PPI. Taiwan export print is Greater China color — not Event Calendar (mainland-only).
